Purpose: Define how agents estimate section containers, borders, and crops from screenshots.
PartitioningRules: Always preserve the original full-page screenshot at page level.
Create component screenshots only when the component boundary is sufficiently clear.
Use visual section containers, borders, spacing, background changes, alignment, and hierarchy to estimate crop boundaries.
Include slight padding around crops so shadows, glows, popovers, badges, and floating controls are not clipped.
If a border is unclear, keep the broader region and mark boundary confidence as Medium or Low.
Do not crop out contextual labels required to understand the component.
Do not invent hidden offscreen UI.

High.Meaning: Clear visual border, container, or region separation.

Medium.Meaning: Region is distinguishable by spacing/alignment, but edge is inferred.
Medium.Action: Crop with padding and mark EstimatedBoundary.

Low.Action: Avoid crop or use parent screenshot reference.

EstimatedBoundingBoxFormat.Units: pixels when known, percentage when exact pixel coordinates are not available

PageLevel.Rule: Desktop, tablet, and mobile variants stay in same Page folder when they represent the same page.

ComponentLevel.Rule: Component variant screenshots stay in the same component folder when they represent the same component.

RequiredBehavior: Use vision models to identify regions before cropping.
Use image tools to crop only after a region plan is written.
Verify generated crop files exist on disk.
